args: Identify the blue cream cheese carton, not the bowl or stove. Request named actual depth points f0,f1,f2,f3 spread INSIDE its flat top-label face, t0,t1,t2 spread noncollinearly on the adjacent bare support table, and bowl at the visible bowl interior center. Return four true top-face boundary corners in cyclic order as corners_uv in camera; these are ray/plane landmarks, not depth samples. Confirm a flat carton resting on this table and a visibly supported overhead approach/open-finger descent lane. Inspect nearby bowl, stove, plate and bottle against the supplied own finger envelope; do not certify hidden clearance. Use the best current view.

result.explanation: Both current views identify the blue Cream Cheese carton, not the bowl or stove. The wrist view clearly shows its flat rectangular top-label face and its placement flat on the bare table. For fingers spanning the short dimension, the visible table strips beside the carton support a local overhead, open-finger descent with the supplied finger envelope. The nearby bowl, stove, plate and bottle are outside that visible local footprint. This is not a certificate for hidden geometry or the full lateral transit.

parameters.notes: Corners are cyclic top-face boundary ray/plane landmarks, not depth samples. f0-f3 are spread inside the label face; t0-t2 are noncollinear bare-table samples. bowl selects the visible interior center. Regions provide visible local support and neighboring-object geometry. Hidden undersides and unseen clearance are not certified; robot self-occlusion at the bottom of the wrist image does not obscure the carton descent lane.
